In this section we prove that \(\left(\mathbb{C}_1^n,\stackrel {\sharp}{\leq}\right)\) is a lower semillattice if and only if \(n\leq 2\). In order to do that, we establish a characterization of the matrices that are above a given matrix \(A\) in terms of its Jordan canonical form.
